name: Faber
summary: Experimental statically typed language and CLI (faber check/run/emit) for coding agents and human authors; compiles to Rust, TypeScript, Go, Swift and more.
description: Faber Romanus is designed so models can write programs and people can read them. Mechanical grammar, explicit static/generic types, math-oriented operators, and sealed reader locales so the same program reads in eight human languages. Agents install via https://faberlang.dev/install.md or `npx skills add https://faberlang.dev`. Front end, runner, stdlib and grammar are MIT OR Apache-2.0; code generators in the release binary are closed-source. Experimental through 1.x (current release 1.18.1).

agent_access.notes: Install the CLI from https://faberlang.dev/install.md; agent skills at https://faberlang.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json (`npx skills add https://faberlang.dev`).
